Mariahilf ( German pronunciation: [maˌʁiːaˈhɪlf] ⓘ ; Viennese : Mariahüf ; "Mary's help") is the 6th municipal district of Vienna , Austria ( German : 6. Bezirk ). It is near the center of Vienna and was established as a district in 1850. [ 2 ] Mariahilf is a heavily populated urban area with many residential buildings. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] It has a population of 31,621 (as of January 2016) within an area of 1.48 square kilometres (0.6 sq mi).
